title: Why Are Ukraine and Russia Fighting?
question: Why are Ukraine and Russia fighting?

news.title: Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia, striking oil terminal in St. Petersburg
news.summary: Ukraine carried out a large-scale drone attack on Russia, with over 1,000 drones hitting targets including an oil terminal in St. Petersburg and causing fires. President Zelenskyy said Russia struck Ukraine with nearly 2,700 drones, 1,700 aerial bombs, and 66 missiles over the past week, mainly targeting energy facilities in an attempt to cause blackouts. The attack comes as the United States weighs further sanctions on Russia.
news.why_it_matters: The strike marks a significant escalation in the Russia-Ukraine war with direct implications for global energy markets and international diplomatic efforts to end the conflict.
